newsitem.title: UK: Stg rally to dampen UK inflation-Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Stg rally to dampen UK inflation-Treasury.

text.p: Alan Budd, chief economic adviser to the Treasury, said on Tuesday said sterling's recent rally would have a downward effect on retail prices, but it was difficult to estimate by how much.
"The effect of sterling's rally has already fed through to lower import prices. We saw that in the third quarter," he told the House of Commons Treasury Select Committee.
"But its effect on retail prices is far from mechanical. It would be misleading to set a single figure, but it is apparent it will have a downard effect on prices."
Sterling has appreciated by over ten percent on a trade weighted basis since the summer.
